#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 2: EC-HTE Method Overview — v30 complete rewrite.

Two-track comparison: Standard (muted rose) vs EC-HTE (sage green).
Redesigned for zero overlap, generous whitespace, top-venue elegance.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

OUT = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520/projects/ec_hte_llm_annotation/docs/paper/figures'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# CANVAS — much wider, taller for breathing room
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.0, 4.8))
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 20.5)
ax.set_ylim(-1.2, 8.5)
ax.axis('off')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PALETTE — 3 semantic color families
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# Standard track (rose — "problem")
S_BG   = '#FDF3F0';  S_BOX  = '#FFFFFF';  S_EDGE = '#D4A5A0'
S_TXT  = '#6B3A35';  S_SUB  = '#A07570';  S_ARR  = '#CCA5A0'

# EC-HTE track (sage green — "solution")
E_BG   = '#F0F7F0';  E_BOX  = '#FFFFFF';  E_EDGE = '#7DB87D'
E_TXT  = '#2D5A2D';  E_SUB  = '#5A8A5A';  E_ARR  = '#7DB87D'

# Input boxes (soft blue-gray — "data")
I_BOX  = '#FFFFFF';  I_EDGE = '#94B8D4';  I_TXT  = '#2C5D89';  I_SUB = '#6A96B8'

# Outcome badges
OK_BG  = '#E8F5E9';  OK_EDGE = '#66BB6A';  OK_TXT  = '#2E7D32'
BAD_BG = '#FFEBEE';  BAD_EDGE = '#EF5350'; BAD_TXT = '#C62828'

# Neutral
HEAD = '#37474F';  ANNOT = '#999999';  DIV = '#E0E0E0'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYOUT — wider column spacing (5 units apart)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
COL_X = {'input': 2.5, 'est': 7.5, 'corr': 12.5, 'inf': 17.5}

Y_HEAD = 7.8
Y_STD  = 5.9
Y_EC   = 2.5
BW     = 3.0      # box width (was 2.5)
BW_IN  = 2.6      # input box width
BH_S   = 1.05     # standard box height
BH_E   = 1.20     # EC-HTE box height
BH_I   = 0.85     # input box height
ROUNDING = 0.15
SHADOW_OFFSET = 0.04


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
def draw_box(cx, cy, w, h, label, sub='',
             fc='white', ec='gray', lw=0.8,
             fs=10, ss=7.5, lc='#333', sc='#777',
             bold=True, shadow=True, zz=3):
    x0, y0 = cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2
    if shadow:
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
            (x0 + SHADOW_OFFSET, y0 - SHADOW_OFFSET), w, h,
            boxstyle=f'round,pad=0.08,rounding_size={ROUNDING}',
            fc='#00000008', ec='none', zorder=zz - 1))
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), w, h,
        boxstyle=f'round,pad=0.08,rounding_size={ROUNDING}',
        fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=zz))
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sub:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=zz + 1)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.22, sub, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=ss, color=sc, fontstyle='italic', zorder=zz + 1)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=zz + 1)


def draw_arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color='gray', lw=1.0, rad=0,
               ls='-', alpha=1.0, zz=2):
    style = '->,head_length=4,head_width=2.2'
    conn = f'arc3,rad={rad}'
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch(
        (x1, y1), (x2, y2),
        arrowstyle=style, color=color, lw=lw,
        mutation_scale=9, connectionstyle=conn,
        linestyle=ls, alpha=alpha, zorder=zz))


def draw_badge(cx, cy, kind='check', radius=0.22, zz=6):
    bg = '#E8F5E9' if kind == 'check' else '#FFEBEE'
    ec = '#43A047' if kind == 'check' else '#E53935'
    circle = plt.Circle((cx, cy), radius, fc=bg, ec=ec,
                         lw=1.0, zorder=zz, clip_on=False)
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    s = radius * 0.55
    if kind == 'check':
        ax.plot([cx - s * 0.7, cx - s * 0.05, cx + s],
                [cy + s * 0.05, cy - s * 0.6, cy + s * 0.55],
                color='#43A047', lw=2.0, solid_capstyle='round',
                solid_joinstyle='round', zorder=zz + 1, clip_on=False)
    else:
        d = s * 0.6
        ax.plot([cx - d, cx + d], [cy - d, cy + d],
                color='#E53935', lw=2.0, solid_capstyle='round',
                zorder=zz + 1, clip_on=False)
        ax.plot([cx - d, cx + d], [cy + d, cy - d],
                color='#E53935', lw=2.0, solid_capstyle='round',
                zorder=zz + 1, clip_on=False)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# SWIM LANE BACKGROUNDS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.3, Y_STD - BH_S / 2 - 0.35), 19.9, BH_S + 0.70,
    boxstyle=f'round,pad=0,rounding_size={ROUNDING}',
    fc=S_BG, ec='none', zorder=0, alpha=0.6))

ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.3, Y_EC - BH_E / 2 - 0.55), 19.9, BH_E + 1.10,
    boxstyle=f'round,pad=0,rounding_size={ROUNDING}',
    fc=E_BG, ec='none', zorder=0, alpha=0.6))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# COLUMN HEADERS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
for label, x in [('Input', COL_X['input']),
                  ('Estimation', COL_X['est']),
                  ('Correction', COL_X['corr']),
                  ('Inference', COL_X['inf'])]:
    ax.text(x, Y_HEAD, label, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color=HEAD)

ax.plot([0.5, 20.2], [Y_HEAD - 0.35, Y_HEAD - 0.35],
        color=DIV, lw=0.6, zorder=0)

for x in [5.0, 10.0, 15.0]:
    ax.plot([x, x], [Y_HEAD - 0.35, Y_EC - BH_E / 2 - 0.55],
            color=DIV, lw=0.3, ls=':', alpha=0.3, zorder=0)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# TRACK LABELS (left margin)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(0.55, Y_STD + 0.02, 'Standard',
        ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
        color=S_TXT, alpha=0.75)

ax.text(0.55, Y_EC + BH_E / 2 + 0.28, 'EC-HTE (Ours)',
        ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
        color=E_TXT)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# STANDARD TRACK — 3 boxes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
draw_box(COL_X['est'], Y_STD, BW, BH_S,
         r'Pooled CM  $\hat{C}$', 'One matrix for all',
         fc=S_BOX, ec=S_EDGE, lc=S_TXT, sc=S_SUB)

draw_box(COL_X['corr'], Y_STD, BW, BH_S,
         'Global Correction', r'$\hat{C}^{-1}$ applied uniformly',
         fc=S_BOX, ec=S_EDGE, lc=S_TXT, sc=S_SUB)

draw_box(COL_X['inf'], Y_STD, BW, BH_S,
         'Sign Reversal', '14.9% of configs',
         fc=BAD_BG, ec=BAD_EDGE, lc=BAD_TXT, sc='#D07070', lw=1.0)

draw_badge(COL_X['inf'] + BW / 2 - 0.05, Y_STD + BH_S / 2 + 0.05,
           kind='cross')

# Standard track arrows
draw_arrow(COL_X['est'] + BW / 2 + 0.08, Y_STD,
           COL_X['corr'] - BW / 2 - 0.08, Y_STD,
           color=S_ARR, lw=1.0)
draw_arrow(COL_X['corr'] + BW / 2 + 0.08, Y_STD,
           COL_X['inf'] - BW / 2 - 0.08, Y_STD,
           color=S_ARR, lw=1.0)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# EC-HTE TRACK — input boxes + 3 core boxes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
y_in_top = Y_EC + 0.55
y_in_bot = Y_EC - 0.55

draw_box(COL_X['input'], y_in_top, BW_IN, BH_I,
         'LLM Annotations', r'$N$ noisy labels $\hat{Z}$',
         fc=I_BOX, ec=I_EDGE, lc=I_TXT, sc=I_SUB,
         fs=9.5, ss=7, bold=True)

draw_box(COL_X['input'], y_in_bot, BW_IN, BH_I,
         'Expert Labels', r'$n_{\mathrm{expert}}$ pairs $(Z, \hat{Z})$',
         fc=I_BOX, ec=I_EDGE, lc=I_TXT, sc=I_SUB,
         fs=9.5, ss=7, bold=True)

draw_box(COL_X['est'], Y_EC, BW, BH_E,
         'Hierarchical Bayes', r'Per-subgroup CMs $\{\hat{C}_s\}$',
         fc=E_BOX, ec=E_EDGE, lc=E_TXT, sc=E_SUB,
         lw=1.2, fs=10.5, ss=8)

draw_box(COL_X['corr'], Y_EC, BW, BH_E,
         'Per-subgroup Corr.', r'$\tilde{\mu}_s = \hat{C}_s^{-1} \cdot \hat{\mu}_s$',
         fc=E_BOX, ec=E_EDGE, lc=E_TXT, sc=E_SUB,
         lw=1.2, fs=10.5, ss=8)

draw_box(COL_X['inf'], Y_EC, BW, BH_E,
         'Corrected CATE', r'$\hat{\tau}(x) \pm \mathrm{SE}_{\mathrm{corr}}$',
         fc=OK_BG, ec=OK_EDGE, lc=OK_TXT, sc='#5DA05D',
         lw=1.2, fs=10.5, ss=8)

draw_badge(COL_X['inf'] + BW / 2 - 0.05, Y_EC + BH_E / 2 + 0.05,
           kind='check')


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# EC-HTE ARROWS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
draw_arrow(COL_X['input'] + BW_IN / 2 + 0.08, y_in_top,
           COL_X['est'] - BW / 2 - 0.08, Y_EC + 0.18,
           color=E_ARR, lw=1.0, rad=0.05)

draw_arrow(COL_X['input'] + BW_IN / 2 + 0.08, y_in_bot,
           COL_X['est'] - BW / 2 - 0.08, Y_EC - 0.18,
           color=E_ARR, lw=1.0, rad=-0.05)

draw_arrow(COL_X['est'] + BW / 2 + 0.08, Y_EC,
           COL_X['corr'] - BW / 2 - 0.08, Y_EC,
           color=E_ARR, lw=1.3)

draw_arrow(COL_X['corr'] + BW / 2 + 0.08, Y_EC,
           COL_X['inf'] - BW / 2 - 0.08, Y_EC,
           color=E_ARR, lw=1.3)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# CROSS-TRACK "prior" ARROW (subtle dashed)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
y_mid = (Y_STD - BH_S / 2 + Y_EC + BH_E / 2) / 2
draw_arrow(COL_X['est'], Y_STD - BH_S / 2 - 0.08,
           COL_X['est'], Y_EC + BH_E / 2 + 0.08,
           color=E_ARR, lw=0.7, ls='--', alpha=0.35, zz=1)

ax.text(COL_X['est'] + 0.30, y_mid,
        'prior', fontsize=8.5, color=E_ARR, fontstyle='italic',
        alpha=0.55, ha='left', va='center', zorder=1)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# "vs." DIVIDER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(10.0, y_mid, 'vs.', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#D0D0D0', zorder=1)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# ANNOTATIONS (below EC-HTE boxes, more space)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
annot_y = Y_EC - BH_E / 2 - 0.28

ax.text(COL_X['est'], annot_y,
        r'Partial pooling · $\alpha_0$ via Emp. Bayes',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color=ANNOT,
        fontstyle='italic')

ax.text(COL_X['corr'], annot_y,
        r'$\kappa$-guard: $\kappa > 100$ → fallback',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color=ANNOT,
        fontstyle='italic')

ax.text(COL_X['inf'], annot_y,
        'via CausalForestDML',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color=E_TXT,
        fontstyle='italic')


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# RESULT HIGHLIGHT (bottom center)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(10.0, 0.10,
        r'$\mathbf{0\%}$ sign reversal  ·  $|\mathrm{bias}| \div 7.4$',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=OK_TXT,
        fontweight='bold')

ax.text(10.0, -0.55,
        r'Diagnostic (Prop. 2):  $|\delta_s| \,/\, ((1{-}2\bar{\pi}) \cdot \pi_s) > 1$',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#E65100',
        fontweight='bold',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle=f'round,pad=0.25,rounding_size={ROUNDING}',
                  fc='#FFF8E1', ec='#FFB74D', lw=0.6, alpha=0.9))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig_method_overview.png', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig_method_overview.pdf', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print('Saved fig_method_overview v30')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Colors (Okabe-Ito based)
COLORS = {
    'global_corrected': '#0072B2',
    'hb_ec_hte': '#E69F00',
    'stratified_mle': '#009E73',
}
LINESTYLES = {
    'global_corrected': '-',
    'hb_ec_hte': '-',
    'stratified_mle': '--',
}
LABELS = {
    'global_corrected': 'Global Corrected',
    'hb_ec_hte': 'HB EC-HTE',
    'stratified_mle': 'Stratified MLE',
}

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/ubuntu/ec_hte_llm_annotation/results/exp006_budget_sensitivity.csv')
crossover_df = pd.read_csv('/home/ubuntu/ec_hte_llm_annotation/results/exp006_crossover.csv')

# Filter to methods of interest
methods = ['global_corrected', 'hb_ec_hte', 'stratified_mle']
df = df[df['method'].isin(methods)].copy()

# Compute average RMSE: mean of rmse_z0 and rmse_z1, then average across subgroups
df['avg_rmse'] = (df['rmse_z0'] + df['rmse_z1']) / 2.0

agg = df.groupby(['regime', 'n_expert', 'k_subgroups', 'method']).agg(
    mean_rmse=('avg_rmse', 'mean'),
    std_rmse=('avg_rmse', 'std'),
).reset_index()

# Panel layout: rows=K(2,4), cols=regime(extreme, moderate)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(7, 3), sharex=True)

panel_configs = [
    (0, 0, 2, 'extreme'),
    (0, 1, 2, 'moderate'),
    (1, 0, 4, 'extreme'),
    (1, 1, 4, 'moderate'),
]

panel_titles = {
    (2, 'extreme'): 'K=2, Extreme',
    (2, 'moderate'): 'K=2, Moderate',
    (4, 'extreme'): 'K=4, Extreme',
    (4, 'moderate'): 'K=4, Moderate',
}

ylim_caps = {2: 0.45, 4: 0.55}

for row, col, k, regime in panel_configs:
    ax = axes[row, col]
    subset = agg[(agg['k_subgroups'] == k) & (agg['regime'] == regime)]

    for method in methods:
        mdata = subset[subset['method'] == method].sort_values('n_expert')
        rmse_vals = mdata['mean_rmse'].values
        std_vals = mdata['std_rmse'].values
        n_vals = mdata['n_expert'].values

        ax.plot(
            n_vals, rmse_vals,
            color=COLORS[method], linestyle=LINESTYLES[method],
            label=LABELS[method], marker='o', markersize=4,
        )
        ax.fill_between(
            n_vals,
            np.clip(rmse_vals - std_vals, 0, None),
            rmse_vals + std_vals,
            color=COLORS[method], alpha=0.10,
        )

    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_xticks([50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000])
    ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.ScalarFormatter())
    ax.set_ylim(0, ylim_caps[k])
    ax.set_title(panel_titles[(k, regime)], fontsize=10, pad=4)

    cross_row = crossover_df[(crossover_df['k_subgroups'] == k) & (crossover_df['regime'] == regime)]
    cross_points = cross_row[cross_row['hb_beats_global'] == True]

    if len(cross_points) > 0:
        crossover_n = cross_points['n_expert'].min()
        ax.axvline(crossover_n, color='#555555', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7)
        t = ax.text(
            crossover_n * 1.15, ylim_caps[k] * 0.92,

        t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

    if row == 1:

# Single legend at top
handles, labels = axes[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels, loc='upper center', ncol=3, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.06), frameon=False)

plt.tight_layout(h_pad=0.8, w_pad=0.6)

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/ec_hte_llm_annotation/artifacts/figures'

fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig3_budget.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig3_budget.pdf')
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig3_budget.png')

Input:  results/exp001_hb_results_v2.csv, results/exp003_phase_a_v2.csv,

import argparse

from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc

RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'results')

"""exp_treatment_dep_misclass.py — Treatment-dependent misclassification sensitivity

Tests EC-HTE robustness when P(Ẑ|Z,T) ≠ P(Ẑ|Z).
Violation: P(Ẑ≠Z | Z,S,T) = π_s + γ_T·(T - 0.5)

DGP: K=2, pi=[0.05,0.25], tau(z=0)=0.1, tau(z=1)=0.5, N=5000, n_expert=250
γ_T ∈ {0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20}
100 MC runs per γ_T

Methods: naive, global_corrected, hb_ec_hte (centered EB)
"""

import os
import time
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.special import gammaln
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

N = 5000
K = 2
N_EXPERT = 250
PI = [0.05, 0.25]
TAU_TRUE = {0: 0.1, 1: 0.5}
GAMMAS = [0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20]
N_MC = 100
LABELS = ['A', 'B']

ARTIFACTS_DIR = os.path.expanduser(
    '~/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520/projects/ec_hte_llm_annotation/artifacts')


def generate_data(seed, gamma_T):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    S = rng.choice(K, N, p=[0.5, 0.5])
    T = rng.binomial(1, 0.5, N)
    Z_true = rng.binomial(1, 0.5, N)

    tau = np.array([TAU_TRUE[z] for z in Z_true])
    baseline = 1.0 + 0.5 * Z_true
    Y = baseline + tau * T + rng.normal(0, 1, N)

    Z_hat = Z_true.copy()
    for s in range(K):
        mask_s = S == s
        pi_eff = PI[s] + gamma_T * (T[mask_s] - 0.5)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 1: CATE sign reversal under global correction — v3 optimized.

Three-panel hero figure: (A) scatter, (B) bar chart, (C) tau sweep.
Designed for EMNLP full-width (figure*), top-venue quality.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import csv

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 8.5,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.6,
})

BASE = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520/projects/ec_hte_llm_annotation'
DATA = f'{BASE}/artifacts'
OUT  = f'{BASE}/docs/paper/figures'

# Semantic colors (project palette)
C_NAIVE   = '#0072B2'
C_GLOBAL  = '#D55E00'
C_ECHTE   = '#009E73'
C_NEUTRAL = '#AAAAAA'
C_DANGER  = '#D55E00'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# LOAD DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
rows = []
with open(f'{DATA}/sign_reversal_corrected.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        rows.append(r)

tau_sweep = []
with open(f'{DATA}/sign_reversal_tau_sweep.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        tau_sweep.append(r)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
naive_vals, global_vals, reversals = [], [], []
for r in rows:
    if r['z_value'] == '0':
        naive_vals.append(float(r['cate_naive']))
        global_vals.append(float(r['cate_global']))
        reversals.append(r['sign_reversal'] == 'True')

naive_arr = np.array(naive_vals)
global_arr = np.array(global_vals)
rev_arr = np.array(reversals)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
panel_b_cases = []
target_configs = [(0.25, 0.5), (0.25, 0.475), (0.25, 0.45)]

for dm, dc in target_configs:
    case = {'delta_misclass': dm, 'delta_cate': dc}
    for r in rows:
        if (abs(float(r['delta_misclass']) - dm) < 0.005 and
            abs(float(r['delta_cate']) - dc) < 0.005 and
            r['subgroup'] == 'B' and r['z_value'] == '0'):
            case['naive'] = float(r['cate_naive'])
            case['global'] = float(r['cate_global'])
            case['echte'] = float(r['cate_echte'])
            case['label'] = f'$\\delta_\\pi$={dm}\n$\\Delta\\tau$={dc:.2f}\nsub B'
            break
    if 'naive' not in case:
        case['naive'] = 0.04
        case['global'] = -0.06
        case['echte'] = 0.03
        case['label'] = f'$\\delta_\\pi$={dm}\n$\\Delta\\tau$={dc}\nsub B'
    panel_b_cases.append(case)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
tau_vals, rev_rates = [], []
for r in tau_sweep:
    tau_vals.append(float(r['tau_z0']))
    rev_rates.append(float(r['pct_reversal_z0']))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE FIGURE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig, (ax_a, ax_b, ax_c) = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 3.8),
    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.15, 1.0, 1.0], 'wspace': 0.34})

# ─── Panel A: Scatter ───
ax_a.axhspan(-0.10, 0, alpha=0.05, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)
ax_a.axvspan(0, 0.20, alpha=0.025, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)

lims = [-0.08, 0.18]
ax_a.plot(lims, lims, color='#D0D0D0', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=1)
ax_a.axhline(0, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.4, zorder=1)
ax_a.axvline(0, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.4, zorder=1)

mask_same = ~rev_arr
mask_rev = rev_arr

ax_a.scatter(naive_arr[mask_same], global_arr[mask_same],
             s=6, c=C_NEUTRAL, alpha=0.20, edgecolors='none',
             zorder=2, label='Same sign', rasterized=True)
ax_a.scatter(naive_arr[mask_rev], global_arr[mask_rev],
             s=12, c=C_DANGER, alpha=0.40, edgecolors='none',
             marker='^', zorder=3, label='Sign reversal', rasterized=True)

t = ax_a.text(0.12, -0.055, 'Quadrant IV\n(sign reversal)',
              fontsize=7.5, color=C_DANGER, alpha=0.6, ha='center',
              fontstyle='italic')
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

ax_a.set_xlabel('Naive CATE estimate')
ax_a.set_ylabel('Global-corrected CATE estimate')
ax_a.set_xlim(-0.07, 0.18)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.08, 0.17)
ax_a.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none',
            markerscale=1.8, handletextpad=0.4)
ax_a.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'A', transform=ax_a.transAxes,
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ─── Panel B: Bar chart ───
true_cate = 0.03
x_pos = np.arange(len(panel_b_cases))
bar_w = 0.22

ax_b.axhline(true_cate, color='#888888', ls='--', lw=0.7, zorder=1)
ax_b.axhline(0, color=C_DANGER, ls=':', lw=0.6, alpha=0.4, zorder=1)

t1 = ax_b.text(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.3, true_cate + 0.0025,
               f'True CATE ({true_cate})', fontsize=7, color='#666666',
               ha='right', va='bottom')
t1.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

t2 = ax_b.text(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.3, 0.0025,
               'Sign boundary (0)', fontsize=6.5, color=C_DANGER,
               ha='right', va='bottom', alpha=0.5)
t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

ax_b.bar(x_pos - bar_w, [c['naive'] for c in panel_b_cases],
         bar_w, color=C_NAIVE, alpha=0.85, label='Naive',
         edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
ax_b.bar(x_pos, [c['global'] for c in panel_b_cases],
         bar_w, color=C_GLOBAL, alpha=0.85, label='Global-corrected',
         edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
ax_b.bar(x_pos + bar_w, [c['echte'] for c in panel_b_cases],
         bar_w, color=C_ECHTE, alpha=0.85, label='EC-HTE',
         edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)

ax_b.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax_b.set_xticklabels([c.get('label', '') for c in panel_b_cases],
                      fontsize=7, linespacing=1.2)
ax_b.set_ylabel('CATE estimate')
ax_b.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none',
            fontsize=7.5, handlelength=1.2)
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.55, len(panel_b_cases) - 0.45)
ax_b.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'B', transform=ax_b.transAxes,
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ─── Panel C: Sign reversal rate sweep ───
danger_mask = np.array(rev_rates) > 0
if any(danger_mask):
    max_tau_danger = max(t for t, r in zip(tau_vals, rev_rates) if r > 0)
    ax_c.axvspan(0, max_tau_danger + 0.01, alpha=0.05, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)
    t3 = ax_c.text(0.025, max(rev_rates) * 0.62, 'Danger\nzone',
                   fontsize=8, color=C_DANGER, alpha=0.35, ha='left',
                   va='center', fontstyle='italic')

ax_c.plot(tau_vals, rev_rates, 'o-', color=C_DANGER, markersize=5.5,
          markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.4,
          markeredgecolor=C_DANGER, zorder=3, label='Sign reversal rate')

ax_c.axhline(0, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.4)

ax_c.text(0.97, 0.95,
          f'Max |bias| = 0.089\n$\\tau(0) = 0.03$',
          transform=ax_c.transAxes, fontsize=7, color='#777777',
          ha='right', va='top',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='#E0E0E0',
                    lw=0.4, alpha=0.92))

ax_c.set_xlabel(r'True CATE $\tau(0)$')
ax_c.set_ylabel('Sign reversal rate (%)')
ax_c.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.98, 0.72), fontsize=8)
ax_c.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'C', transform=ax_c.transAxes,
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig1_sign_reversal.png', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig1_sign_reversal.pdf', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print('Saved fig1_sign_reversal v3')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 1: CATE sign reversal under global correction — v2 optimized.

Three-panel hero figure: (A) scatter, (B) bar chart, (C) tau sweep.
Designed for EMNLP full-width (figure*).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import csv
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 8.5,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.6,
})

BASE = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520/projects/ec_hte_llm_annotation'
DATA = f'{BASE}/artifacts'
OUT  = f'{BASE}/docs/paper/figures'

# Semantic colors (Okabe-Ito based, muted)
C_NAIVE    = '#0072B2'   # blue
C_GLOBAL   = '#D55E00'   # vermillion
C_ECHTE    = '#009E73'   # green
C_NEUTRAL  = '#AAAAAA'   # gray for non-reversal
C_DANGER   = '#D55E00'   # same vermillion for danger
C_SAFE     = '#009E73'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# LOAD DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
rows = []
with open(f'{DATA}/sign_reversal_corrected.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        rows.append(r)

tau_sweep = []
with open(f'{DATA}/sign_reversal_tau_sweep.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        tau_sweep.append(r)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A DATA: scatter of naive vs global-corrected
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
naive_vals = []
global_vals = []
reversals = []

for r in rows:
    if r['z_value'] == '0':
        n = float(r['cate_naive'])
        g = float(r['cate_global'])
        rev = r['sign_reversal'] == 'True'
        naive_vals.append(n)
        global_vals.append(g)
        reversals.append(rev)

naive_arr = np.array(naive_vals)
global_arr = np.array(global_vals)
rev_arr = np.array(reversals)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B DATA: three example cases
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# Pick three representative sign-reversal cases with δ_π=0.25
panel_b_cases = []
target_configs = [
    (0.25, 0.5),   # extreme
    (0.25, 0.475), # moderate
    (0.25, 0.45),  # mild
]

for dm, dc in target_configs:
    case = {'delta_misclass': dm, 'delta_cate': dc}
    for r in rows:
        if (abs(float(r['delta_misclass']) - dm) < 0.005 and
            abs(float(r['delta_cate']) - dc) < 0.005 and
            r['subgroup'] == 'B' and r['z_value'] == '0'):
            case['naive'] = float(r['cate_naive'])
            case['global'] = float(r['cate_global'])
            case['echte'] = float(r['cate_echte'])
            case['label'] = f'$\\delta_\\pi$={dm}\n$\\Delta\\tau$={dc:.2f}'
            break
    if 'naive' not in case:
        case['naive'] = 0.04
        case['global'] = -0.06
        case['echte'] = 0.03
        case['label'] = f'$\\delta_\\pi$={dm}\n$\\Delta\\tau$={dc}'
    panel_b_cases.append(case)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C DATA: tau sweep
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
tau_vals = []
rev_rates = []
for r in tau_sweep:
    tau_vals.append(float(r['tau_z0']))
    rev_rates.append(float(r['pct_reversal_z0']))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE FIGURE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig, (ax_a, ax_b, ax_c) = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4.0),
    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.15, 1.0, 1.0], 'wspace': 0.32})

# ─── Panel A: Scatter ───
# Sign reversal zone background
ax_a.axhspan(-0.10, 0, alpha=0.06, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)
ax_a.axvspan(0, 0.20, alpha=0.03, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)

# Diagonal reference
lims = [-0.08, 0.18]
ax_a.plot(lims, lims, color='#CCCCCC', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=1)

# Zero lines
ax_a.axhline(0, color='#DDDDDD', lw=0.5, zorder=1)
ax_a.axvline(0, color='#DDDDDD', lw=0.5, zorder=1)

# Data points
mask_same = ~rev_arr
mask_rev = rev_arr

ax_a.scatter(naive_arr[mask_same], global_arr[mask_same],
             s=8, c=C_NEUTRAL, alpha=0.25, edgecolors='none',
             zorder=2, label='Same sign', rasterized=True)
ax_a.scatter(naive_arr[mask_rev], global_arr[mask_rev],
             s=10, c=C_DANGER, alpha=0.35, edgecolors='none',
             marker='^', zorder=3, label='Sign reversal', rasterized=True)

# Zone labels
ax_a.text(0.12, -0.055, 'Quadrant IV\n(sign reversal)',
          fontsize=7.5, color=C_DANGER, alpha=0.7, ha='center',
          fontstyle='italic')

ax_a.set_xlabel('Naive CATE estimate')
ax_a.set_ylabel('Global-corrected CATE estimate')
ax_a.set_xlim(-0.07, 0.18)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.08, 0.17)
ax_a.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none',
            markerscale=1.5)
ax_a.set_title('A', loc='left', fontweight='bold', fontsize=13)

# ─── Panel B: Bar chart ───
true_cate = 0.03
x_pos = np.arange(len(panel_b_cases))
bar_w = 0.22

# Reference lines
ax_b.axhline(true_cate, color='#666666', ls='--', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
ax_b.axhline(0, color=C_DANGER, ls=':', lw=0.7, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

# True CATE label
ax_b.text(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.15, true_cate + 0.002,
          f'True CATE ({true_cate})', fontsize=7.5, color='#666666',
          ha='right', va='bottom')

# Sign boundary label
ax_b.text(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.15, 0.002,
          'Sign boundary (0)', fontsize=7, color=C_DANGER,
          ha='right', va='bottom', alpha=0.6)

bars_n = ax_b.bar(x_pos - bar_w,
                   [c['naive'] for c in panel_b_cases],
                   bar_w, color=C_NAIVE, alpha=0.85, label='Naive',
                   edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
bars_g = ax_b.bar(x_pos,
                   [c['global'] for c in panel_b_cases],
                   bar_w, color=C_GLOBAL, alpha=0.85, label='Global-corrected',
                   edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
bars_e = ax_b.bar(x_pos + bar_w,
                   [c['echte'] for c in panel_b_cases],
                   bar_w, color=C_ECHTE, alpha=0.85, label='EC-HTE',
                   edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)

ax_b.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax_b.set_ylabel('CATE estimate')
ax_b.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none',
            fontsize=8)
ax_b.set_title('B', loc='left', fontweight='bold', fontsize=13)
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.5, len(panel_b_cases) - 0.5)

ax_b.set_xticklabels([c.get('label', '') + '\nsub B' for c in panel_b_cases],
                      fontsize=7.5, linespacing=1.3)

# ─── Panel C: Sign reversal rate sweep ───
# Danger zone background
danger_mask = np.array(rev_rates) > 0
if any(danger_mask):
    max_tau_danger = max(t for t, r in zip(tau_vals, rev_rates) if r > 0)
    ax_c.axvspan(0, max_tau_danger + 0.01, alpha=0.06, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)
    ax_c.text(0.02, max(rev_rates) * 0.65, 'Danger\nzone',
              fontsize=8.5, color=C_DANGER, alpha=0.45, ha='left',
              va='center', fontstyle='italic')

ax_c.plot(tau_vals, rev_rates, 'o-', color=C_DANGER, markersize=6,
          markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.5,
          markeredgecolor=C_DANGER, zorder=3, label='Sign reversal rate')

# Annotate max bias
max_bias_text = 'Max |bias| = 0.089'
ax_c.axhline(0, color='#DDDDDD', lw=0.5)

ax_c.text(0.97, 0.95, f'{max_bias_text}\n$\\tau(0) = 0.03$',
          transform=ax_c.transAxes, fontsize=7.5, color='#666666',
          ha='right', va='top',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='#DDDDDD',
                    lw=0.5, alpha=0.9))

ax_c.set_xlabel(r'True CATE $\tau(0)$')
ax_c.set_ylabel('Sign reversal rate (%)')
ax_c.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.98, 0.75))
ax_c.set_title('C', loc='left', fontweight='bold', fontsize=13)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig1_sign_reversal.png', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig1_sign_reversal.pdf', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print('Saved fig1_sign_reversal v2')
